look_here_first: Look at the samara first: green ash has a larger seed body with the wing decurrent well down the body before broadening; then confirm a broad shield-shaped leaf scar and usually non-glaucous lower leaflet surface.

project_inclusion.range_basis: 24-county boundary audit 2026-10-14: Hays, Comal qualify; Bell out-of-zone and excluded from PASS. Previous evidence preserved in range_audit; third approved county pending.

best_field_traits: opposite branches and odd-pinnate leaves, usually 5–7(9) leaflets
broad shield-shaped to oblong-ovate leaf scar
samara body >1.5 cm with wing extending well down the seed body
morphology_keys.leaf_morphology: Usually 5–7(9) leaflets; margins subentire to inconspicuously dentate-serrulate.
morphology_keys.abaxial_surface: Generally glabrous/non-glaucous compared with Texas ash.
morphology_keys.leaf_scar: Shield-shaped to broadly oblong-ovate; upper edge truncate to shallowly concave.
morphology_keys.fruit: Consistently 2-winged samara in the Central Texas comparison; wing runs down proximal body then broadens distally.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Texas ash has glaucous wax below and a smaller mostly terminal-winged samara. Mexican ash tends to fewer, more coarsely serrate leaflets and may show occasional 3-winged fruits.

field_diagnostics.single_best_trait: On a fruiting female tree, look for a >1.5 cm samara body with the wing decurrent along the body before broadening distally.
fastest_traits: Broad shield-shaped to oblong-ovate leaf scar
Samara >1.5 cm; wing strongly decurrent; consistently 2-winged

look_alikes.distinction: Texas ash has a smaller ~1 cm seed body, mostly terminal wing and conspicuously glaucous/white-reticulate lower leaflet surface.
Mexican ash tends toward 3–5(–7) more coarsely serrate leaflets; its samara wings expand gradually from near the base and 3-winged fruits can occur.

diagnostic_photo_targets: Mature samara with ruler showing >1.5 cm body and decurrent wing
Lower leaflet macro showing non-glaucous surface

Whole mature 5–7(9) leaflet leaf with margin detail
